focus_areas.area: S3 bucket public access (ACL, bucket policy, Block Public Access)
RDS instance public exposure and encryption
AMI image sharing and snapshot exposure
Unencrypted data in transit and at rest

rule.title: S3 Public Bucket
rule.description: S3 buckets with public ACL or bucket policy allowing anonymous access are Critical
rule.action: Check s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket permissions for Principal: "*"

rule.title: S3 Block Public Access
rule.description: Block Public Access settings should be enabled at account AND bucket level
rule.action: Verify all four Block Public Access settings are True

rule.title: RDS Public Exposure
rule.description: RDS instance with PubliclyAccessible=true is Critical if internet-exposed
rule.action: Check PubliclyAccessible flag and security group ingress from 0.0.0.0/0

rule.title: RDS Encryption
rule.description: RDS instance without encryption at rest is High risk
rule.action: Check StorageEncrypted flag for all DB instances

rule.title: AMI Sharing
rule.description: AMI shared with account: "all" (public) is Critical
rule.action: Identify public AMIs and determine if intentional

rule.title: CloudFront Origin
rule.description: CloudFront distribution with unencrypted origin connection is High
rule.action: Check OriginProtocolPolicy: must be https-only, not http-only

rule.title: EBS Snapshot Sharing
rule.description: EBS snapshots shared with all accounts or public are Critical
rule.action: Check snapshot CreateVolumePermissions for public access

focus.check: Buckets with PublicAccessBlockConfiguration not fully enabled
Bucket policies allowing s3:GetObject with Principal: "*"
ACL set to PublicRead or PublicReadWrite
PubliclyAccessible = true combined with internet-routable security group
Snapshots shared with all AWS accounts
Images with LaunchPermission allowing all accounts
Viewer protocol policy allowing HTTP (not HTTPS-required)
